paper_title: Diaceno[a,e]pentalenes: An Excellent Molecular Platform for High-Performance Organic Semiconductors

knowledge_points.content: The diaceno[a,e]pentalene derivatives (DBP, DNP, DAP) utilize bulky 3,5-di-tert-butylphenyl substituents to manage intermolecular arrangement and steric hindrance.
knowledge_points.evidence: The existence of bulky 3, 5-di-tert-butylphenyl substituents generated great steric hindrance for the intermolecular arrangement.

knowledge_points.content: The thermal stability of diaceno[a,e]pentalenes increases with the extension of the conjugated skeleton, with 5% weight loss temperatures (T5wt%) of 308 °C for DBP, 350 °C for DNP, and 426 °C for DAP.
knowledge_points.evidence: Thermal gravimetric analysis (TGA) curves of compounds (a) DBP (308 °C), (b) DNP (350 °C), and (c) DAP (426 °C).

knowledge_points.content: As the conjugation length increases from DBP to DAP, the HOMO energy levels rise (-5.70 eV for DBP, -5.50 eV for DNP, and -5.26 eV for DAP), while the optical bandgap decreases (2.61 eV to 2.14 eV).
knowledge_points.evidence: Table S1. Photophysical and electrochemical properties... DBP HOMO -5.70 eV, Eopt 2.61 eV; DNP HOMO -5.50 eV, Eopt 2.32 eV; DAP HOMO -5.26 eV, Eopt 2.14 eV.

knowledge_points.content: In diaceno[a,e]pentalene single crystals, the angle between the molecular skeleton and the 3,5-di-tert-butylphenyl substituent decreases as the conjugated skeleton extends: 50.61° for DBP, 46.76° for DNP, and 43.77° for DAP.
knowledge_points.evidence: With the extension of the conjugated molecular skeleton, the angle formed by the molecular skeleton and substituent is gradually smaller. (a) The angle in DBP single crystal is 50.61° (b) The angle in DNP single crystal is 46.76° (c) The angle in DAP single crystal is 43.77°

knowledge_points.content: Single crystals of diaceno[a,e]pentalenes were grown using physical vapor transport (PVT) in a horizontal-tube furnace with ultrahigh-purity argon as the carrier gas at a flow rate of 100 cm³/min.
knowledge_points.evidence: Micro/nanometer-sized single-crystals of these compounds used in this study were grown in typical growth conditions by physical vapor transport (PVT) in a horizontal-tube furnace and the carrier gas was ultrahigh-purity argon at a flow rate of 100 cm3 min-1

knowledge_points.content: The morphology of DAP single crystals is sensitive to the growth temperature during PVT: microribbons form at 280 °C (suppressed {100} face growth), while rectangular crystals form at 320 °C (increased {100} face growth).
knowledge_points.evidence: Figure S11. Growth pattern schematic for DAP single crystal. (a) At 280 °C, the growth rate of {100} faces is suppressed and single crystal microribbons were generated. (b) At 320 °C, the growth rate of {100} faces substantial increase and rectangle crystals were obtained.

knowledge_points.content: The solvent choice in drop-casting significantly impacts DAP crystal morphology: chloroform results in rod-shaped crystals, whereas toluene produces rhombus-shaped crystals.
knowledge_points.evidence: Rod-shaped crystals were obtained with chloroform as the solvent, while rhombus-shaped crystals were obtained with toluene as the solvent.

knowledge_points.content: DAP single-crystal microribbon transistors exhibit a high average charge carrier mobility of 3.47 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ and a maximum mobility of 6.55 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ along the b-axis.
knowledge_points.evidence: Table S3. Field-effect characteristics... DAP (b-axis) (Ribbon crystal) μave (μmax) (cm2V-1 s-1): 3.47 (6.55).

knowledge_points.content: DNP single-crystal transistors demonstrate lower performance compared to DAP, with a maximum mobility of 0.52 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ for hexagonal crystals along the b-axis.
knowledge_points.evidence: Table S3. Field-effect characteristics... DNP (b-axis) (Hexagonal crystal) μave (μmax) (cm2V-1 s-1): 0.14 (0.52).

knowledge_points.content: Thin film transistors based on DAP reached a maximum mobility of 0.87 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹, which is significantly lower than the mobility achieved in its single-crystal counterparts.
knowledge_points.evidence: Figure S15. (b) Thin film transistors based on DAP had a maximum mobility of 0.87 cm2 V-1 s-1

knowledge_points.content: The OFET devices were fabricated using a top-contact bottom-gate (TCBG) configuration, employing an organic nanowire mask method for the precise deposition of 50 nm thick gold (Au) source and drain electrodes.
knowledge_points.evidence: The traditional top-contact bottom-gate devices based on the nano/micro-single crystal were fabricated respectively with the organic nanowire mask method... a layer of Au about 50 nm thick was deposited as the source and drain electrodes.

knowledge_points.content: Selected area electron diffraction (SAED) revealed that the d-spacing along the growth direction for DAP single crystal microribbons prepared by PVT is 0.94 nm.
knowledge_points.evidence: Figure S13. (a) The symmetric diffraction spots from the SAED pattern of DAP single crystal microribbon prepared by PVT show that the d-spacing along the growth direction is 0.94 nm.

knowledge_points.content: Morphology predictions using the Material Studio Package identified the {001} facet as the dominant surface for DBP (40.20% total facet area) and the {200} facet for DNP (56.45% total facet area).
knowledge_points.evidence: Table S2. Surface free and attachment energies... DBP {001} Total facet area (%) 40.20; DNP {200} Total facet area (%) 56.45.
